title: Lost in Translation
description: A man and a woman cannot sleep in a Tokyo hotel. They walk at night and talk a little. English and Japanese.

title: Independence Day
description: Aliens attack Earth. Planes, explosions, and a big speech.

title: Whiplash
description: A young drummer and a teacher who shouts at him. The music is very loud.

title: Run Lola Run
description: Lola has 20 minutes to get money and save her boyfriend. She runs through Berlin. German.

title: Spirited Away
description: A girl is trapped in a bathhouse for spirits and has to work there. Japanese animation.

title: Amélie
description: A shy woman in Paris does small kind things for people. French. Not on this week.

title: Parasite
description: A poor family gets jobs in a rich house in Seoul. Korean.

title: In the Mood for Love
description: Two neighbours in Hong Kong. Slow, sad, not much happens. Cantonese. Not on this week.

title: Pan's Labyrinth
description: A girl in Spain during the war finds a magic world. Also soldiers and danger. Spanish.

title: Mad Max: Fury Road
description: A chase in the desert with cars and sand. Very noisy. Not on this week.

title: Capernaum
description: A boy from a poor part of Beirut takes his parents to court. Arabic.

title: Das Boot
description: A German submarine in World War 2. Small rooms, engines, a lot of waiting. German.
